tool_evidence.tpa_reasoning: L03 and L04 are identical 'Pharmacy - antibiotics' for 9600 each. No distinct date/batch break-up in evidence pack to show separate dispensing. Insurer will pay once and deduct duplicate pending day-wise pharmacy bills with prescriptions.
